claims.statement: Spotify returns a refresh_token alongside the access token in the authorization token response of the user-authorized flows; it is exchanged at the token endpoint with grant_type refresh_token for new access tokens, and for apps registered in the Developer Dashboard it has a lifetime of 6 months that refreshing does not extend.

sources.supports: A refresh token is a security credential that allows client applications to obtain new access tokens without requiring users to reauthorize the application.
Refresh tokens issued to apps registered in the Developer Dashboard have a lifetime of 6 months. ... Refreshing an access token does not extend the refresh token's lifetime.
sources.locator: Refreshing tokens page, section Refresh token lifetime

sources.supports: Flow table: Client credentials - Access User Resources: No; Requires Secret Key (Server-Side): Yes; Access Token Refresh: No.

openQuestions.question: The pages read show only elided example tokens and state no prefix, alphabet or length, so the candidate is not researched beyond existence. Whether the 6-month lifetime applies to apps not registered in the Developer Dashboard is not covered.
